title: halogen backend_config
description: Sectioned backend_config for the halogen provider (Phase 12). x-flag names the exact HALOGEN_* env var; env.py + driver.py remain the executable mapping. Halogen is env-configured (argv is only the entrypoint word `all`). None-skip semantics hold: a null or absent value is never exported and the engine keeps its own default.

artifacts.title: Model files
artifacts.description: Checkpoint and tokenizer artifacts resolved by the driver before spawn (local path or HuggingFace descriptor). Resolved paths are exported as HALOGEN_CHECKPOINT / HALOGEN_TOKENIZER.

model.title: Checkpoint
model.description: Primary .hgn checkpoint (hf-file descriptor or local path). Resolved path exported as HALOGEN_CHECKPOINT.

tokenizer.title: Tokenizer
tokenizer.description: Tokenizer artifact. The engine expects a tokenizer DIRECTORY: use {path} pointing at a local directory (exists() accepts file or dir). A {source:hf,repo,file} descriptor must name a SINGLE downloadable file (the downloader is file-only; it cannot fetch a directory tree) — unpack the tokenizer folder locally and reference it by path. Resolved path exported as HALOGEN_TOKENIZER.

cache.title: Cache Sizing
cache.description: Engine cache pool sizing (MiB) and alignment granularity.

cache_mb.title: Cache size (MiB)
cache_mb.description: Total engine cache pool size in MiB. null/absent = engine default.

cache_reserve_mb.title: Cache reserve (MiB)
cache_reserve_mb.description: Cache headroom kept free of admission. null/absent = engine default.

cache_align.title: Cache alignment
cache_align.description: Cache granularity/alignment unit. null/absent = engine default.

concurrency.title: Concurrency & Slots
concurrency.description: KV-slot request concurrency and queueing policy.

kv_slots.title: KV slots
kv_slots.description: KV cache slots = engine request concurrency. The driver reports this as effective_capacity.

slot_ctx.title: Slot context
slot_ctx.description: Context length per KV slot. null/absent = engine default.

queue_timeout.title: Queue timeout (s)
queue_timeout.description: Max time (seconds) a request waits for a free KV slot before failing. null/absent = engine default.

quantization.title: Quantization
quantization.description: W4A4 kernel selection. Changes output numerics (lower-precision matmuls).

w4a4.title: W4A4 kernels
w4a4.description: Enable W4A4 quantized compute (0 = off, 1 = on). Changes output numerics.

w4a4_excl.title: W4A4 exclusions
w4a4_excl.description: Layers excluded from W4A4 quantization (e.g. 'attn'). null/absent = engine default.

speculative.title: Speculative Decoding
speculative.description: Drafter selection. Drafts only proposals; accepted tokens are still verified by the target model, so outputs stay bitwise-identical.

drafter.title: Drafter
drafter.description: Speculative decoding drafter (e.g. 'mtp'). Proposals only — verification keeps outputs bitwise-identical. null/absent = engine default.

server.title: Server / Request Policy
server.description: HTTP/SSE keepalive and request-length policy knobs.

max_tokens_cap.title: Max tokens cap
max_tokens_cap.description: Hard ceiling on requested max_tokens (policy cap, not sampling). null/absent = engine default.

keepalive_timeout.title: Keepalive timeout (s)
keepalive_timeout.description: HTTP keep-alive timeout in seconds. null/absent = engine default.

sse_keepalive_s.title: SSE keepalive (s)
sse_keepalive_s.description: Keep-alive ping interval for SSE streams in seconds. null/absent = engine default.

networking.title: Networking / Ports
networking.description: Deprecated: halogen ports are no longer operator-configurable. Since the port model overhaul each backend's (api, engine) pair is an OS-assigned private loopback port allocated at start; the admin never learns them. This section accepts no properties.
